shared_elements: horizontal register band of repeated motifs
carved relief frieze running along a wall
repetition of near-identical units in a row
justification: Both surfaces show a long horizontal relief band composed of a repeated, evenly spaced series of units bounded by framing lines, and both stack registers (figures above a lower moulding in A; leaf band over zigzag band in B). But A depicts a procession of naturalistic standing human figures in profile carrying staves, while B depicts abstract vegetal/geometric ornament (drooping leaf or petal forms, chevrons, guilloche) with at most a small ambiguous motif, so the actual subject matter differs almost entirely.
